_comment: The atoms a content verb may compose (Phase EV). Adding one is a PR — but it can only ever proxy an applet verb that already exists in Swift. Content cannot conjure new native power, which is the whole reason a verb manifest is reviewable by reading it.
_safetyNote: safetyClass here is a CEILING REQUEST, not the final word. Swift holds a floor (CapabilityRegistry.knownReadVerbs) and the effective class is max(declared, floor). Content may mark something MORE dangerous than Swift assumed; it can never mark something less. If it could, a verb declared 'read' could compose a write primitive and the class would certify nothing. Anything Swift has not classified floors at 'write' — nothing is blocked, the assumption is just pessimistic until a human says otherwise in the binary.
